laat_vaar_vorige.voor: meestal as reën, en as sneeu
laat_vaar_vorige.na: meestal as reën en as sneeu
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the second half has no subject and verb of its own.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The comma marks snow as a separate addition; without it 'meestal' and 'waar dit koud genoeg is' can be read across both rain and snow, so the meaning moves.
